activation: Only if current linked-history comparison closes without qualifying method; its g/h confirmation takes precedence if qualified. This protocol cannot reinterpret or rerun old experiments.

data.scope: Same exact task/reference/input-generator source; new case configuration only.

primary_criteria.screen: Existing .02 per-task quality allowance, nondecreasing aggregate quality in each repeat, <=5% solver/trial overhead and original .01 quality or .1 cost benefit conditions. All attempts and independent full outcomes required.
primary_criteria.practical: For BOTH acceptance comparisons, >=10% relative quality gain at <=5% wall overhead OR >=10% wall saving at protected quality, plus <=5% token overhead. Unknown usage forbids acceptance.
primary_criteria.uncertainty: Exhaustive paired resampling of 4 operator clusters (both variants/repeats stay together),256 draws,alpha .05/8 across 4 comparisons x2 metrics. Development exploratory only; independent confirmation requires a positive one-sided lower bound for the corresponding accepted benefit in BOTH acceptance comparisons.
primary_criteria.cost: Keep all prior acquisition, development failure, infrastructure and validation resources; missing cost is unknown, not zero. No observed full-campaign ROI without actual recovery of costs.

selection: Only reuse-2 is a candidate method here. control-2 and reuse-4 are factorial ablations, not alternate winners to select after seeing results. Both reuse arms receive exactly the same approved full source and current-runtime/exact-task selection. All four arms use linked_history and default-off bounded decision timeout recovery with independent final full.
stopping: Action cap fixed by arm before any result; prompt states actual remaining_actions. No learned stop-text, no softened evaluator or extra action for artifact. No model/job retries, no resampling.
manager_scope: Package contains new managed bridge but this efficacy comparison uses the same standalone research path in all arms; no claim of measured Manager/GPU production integration.
limitations: Four known formulas with fresh shapes/strides/seeds only, not eight independent operators or native production training.
Reduced search may lose worthwhile refinements; this is why both no-memory references and separate final full remain.
Content identity and approved manifests are not an OS sandbox or universal compatibility proof.
This is a separate explicit budget-allocation mechanism, not a repeat of closed advice/memory/retuning studies.

prior_diagnostic.interpretation: Search-score marginal observation only; does not prove a counterfactual early-stop result or utility.

authorization.execution_budget_receipt: Must bind fresh prior released total and request hash before any submission; no reserved GPU now.
